title: Decision event (JSONL, stdout)
description: The §13 stable event contract for the one JSONL line `run_cycle` (src/main.rs) prints to stdout per account per cycle: `{"event": "decision", "observe_only": ..., "actuated": ..., "decision": <Decision>}`. Mirrors Decision/WindowDecision/BankedResetDecision in src/controller.rs exactly, including the `binding_window` field WP2 added for the §9.6 multi-window arbitration winner. additionalProperties is left open everywhere because the Rust structs do not use #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] -- a field this schema does not yet know about is a forward-compatible addition, not a violation. `reason` and `windows[].reason` are closed enums because they are fixed Rust string literals, not provider- or user-supplied text; adding a new reason value is a change to this file, not just to the binary. This schema covers only the `decision` event -- `status`, `account_error`, and `shutdown` events (also printed per §13/12) are not in scope for this file.

observe_only.description: Echoes the CLI/config observe-only flag for this cycle. When true, `actuated` is always false -- the fleet actuator was never invoked.

actuated.description: Whether the fleet actuator was invoked and reported success this cycle. False for observe-only cycles, a stale decision that held at the current count, and any cycle whose actuation failed (which is instead reported via a separate `account_error` event, not this one).

account.description: The configured account name (a `config.accounts` map key), not a provider-assigned identifier.

current_workers.description: The worker count observed at the start of this cycle, before this decision's actuation (if any).

desired_workers.description: The final desired count after §9.6 multi-window arbitration, the §9.7 banked-reset floor, and the §9.6 per-cycle step limits -- what the fleet actuator was (or, if `actuated` is false, would have been) asked to reach.

stale.description: §9.1 freshness gate. When true, `windows` is always empty and `binding_window`/`banked_resets` are always absent -- a stale cycle observes no windows.

windows.description: One entry per enabled observed window (§9.2 policy resolution), in snapshot order. Always empty for a stale decision; otherwise never empty -- `evaluate` fails the cycle rather than emitting a decision with zero enabled windows.

binding_window.description: The `windows[].id` whose raw desired count won the §9.6 arbitration (the minimum across `windows`), before the banked-reset floor and step limits are applied. Absent for a stale decision. A tie between windows favors the first in snapshot order.

id.description: Echoes the observed QuotaWindow.id this decision was computed for.

used_fraction.description: Echoes the observed window's used_fraction at `decision.observed_at`.

target_utilization.description: The §9.2-resolved target for this window: account default, overridden per-window, reserve_fraction converted to 1 - reserve_fraction, and -- for a weekly window while a banked reset generation is available -- raised to at least banked_resets.redeem_at_utilization (§9.7).

desired_workers.description: This window's own raw desired count, clamped to [fleet.min_workers, fleet.max_workers] but not yet step-limited -- may differ from the top-level `decision.desired_workers`, which additionally applies §9.6 arbitration, the banked-reset floor, and per-cycle step limits.

reason.description: target_reached: used_fraction >= target or the provider's own `reached` flag. reset_due: resets_at has passed but the provider has not published a new generation yet (§9.3) -- holds, does not extrapolate. below_ceiling: Strategy::CeilingOnly, not yet at target. paced_to_reset: Strategy::LinearToReset with a usable same-generation burn-rate sample (§9.4). no_observed_burn: a same-generation sample exists but its delta is censored (quantized-zero, §9.8) -- holds, not a learned zero rate. bootstrap_burn_rate: no usable sample and current_workers == 0. learning_burn_rate: no usable sample and current_workers > 0 -- holds while learning.

observed_burn_per_worker_hour.description: The §9.4 two-point burn-rate estimate (fraction of the window consumed per worker per hour), present only when `reason` is "paced_to_reset". Never present as exactly zero -- see estimate_burn_per_worker's doc comment in src/controller.rs.

bankedResetDecision.description: Present only when config.banked_resets.enabled and the snapshot reports at least one available reset credit (§9.7). Every field is always present together -- unlike `windowDecision.observed_burn_per_worker_hour`, none of these are independently optional.

governing_window.description: The weekly window (highest used_fraction among weekly windows) this banked-reset plan is computed against.

required_burn_per_hour.description: The larger of the minimum banked-pace rate and every known credit's expiry-deadline pace (§9.7).

desired_workers.description: The worker count this banked-reset plan alone requires; acts as a floor on the ordinary weekly pacing result unless manual redemption is recommended or a shorter (non-weekly) window has separately reached its own target.

manual_redemption_recommended.description: True once the governing window reaches redeem_at_utilization (or its own target). The governor has no reset-credit mutation path (ADR-0001) -- a human must redeem before this window resumes pacing.

deadline_missed.description: True when a known credit's expiry-safety deadline has already passed without the required generations being consumed.

known_expirations.description: Every known available credit's expires_at, sorted ascending. May be empty when the provider reports available_count without per-credit detail.
